title: Indian Atlas 039 NW · 1888
source: sources/zenodo-19431985/sheets/039 NW Quarter Sheet Indian Atlas (1888).jpg
condition_note: Intact NW quarter; native publication confirms May 1888. Own printed graticule and frame to be measured.
line_slope_bounds_reason: Native graticule crops show nearly vertical meridians and gently tilted parallels within these bounds.
longitude_convention_status: Printed note gives -69 and -150 arcseconds (total -219). Retain user-selected working correction -216.18 arcseconds, 2.82 arcseconds east of the printed total; modern datum alignment remains provisional.
longitude_correction_basis: User-selected two-correction working hypothesis: -69 arcseconds Atlas to old GTS, then -147.18 arcseconds.

printed_longitude_note.transcription: All Longitudes require a correction of -1′-9″, to reduce them to the origin of the Great Trigonometrical Survey: viz: the Madras Observatory taken as 80°17′21″, and a further correction of -2′30″ to reduce them to the latest value 80°14′51″ of that Observatory.

frame_intensity_limit_reason: Native weakest-frame contact confirms a faint intact northern inner rule at source2452,506 (median intensity191), distinct from the outer black/white graduation strip. Permit up to200 with measured guides and inspect final crop.
frame_stroke_width_reason: Native crop corners show dense hill shading adjoining north/west/south neatlines; cap inward stroke expansion to avoid treating map hachures as frame thickness.

south.reason: Native southwest corner and frame detail show inner southern rule near4174-4176; automatic argmin selects the graduation strip at4182. Final crop follows the inner rule with about five pixels clearance.

west.reason: Native northwest corner and west frame details show the inner vertical rule near449; automatic measurements wander between rule and adjoining hill ink. Final crop is held about five pixels inside that rule over the short northern section.

north.reason: Native northwest/frame details show inner top rule near508, declining gently eastward. Final crop follows it with about six pixels clearance, avoiding adjoining hachures and graduation strip.
